content.user_title: Improve AI Work With Actionable Feedback
content.value_statement: AI outputs can be hard to improve when feedback is vague or unprioritized. This skill turns quality issues into concrete, ranked improvements with examples and verification steps.
actual_capabilities: Identifies correctness, completeness, clarity, efficiency, security, and usability improvement areas.
Converts quality issues into specific proposed changes with rationale and priority.
Provides before-and-after examples for code, explanations, and solution designs.
Suggests verification steps and success criteria for proposed improvements.
Compares alternative approaches and explains trade-offs when relevant.
limitations: Does not run tests or validate changes by itself.
Depends on the context and quality analysis provided by the user.
May need human review for domain-specific requirements.
Contains instructional examples only and does not include automation scripts.

use_cases.title: Improve Code Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Turn broad review comments into prioritized code changes, clear rationale, and verification steps.

use_cases.title: Refine Technical Explanations
use_cases.description: Make explanations clearer, better structured, and more appropriate for the intended audience.

use_cases.title: Plan Quality Improvements
use_cases.description: Convert product or engineering quality gaps into practical improvement plans with trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Improve This Response
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this response and suggest three specific improvements. Include the issue, the proposed change, and why it helps.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Code Improvements
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this code or code review summary. Rank improvements by impact, then give implementation steps and verification criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Explanation
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve this explanation for the stated audience. Identify unclear parts, rewrite the structure, and add examples where useful.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Remediation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for multiple quality issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a staged improvement plan from these findings. Include priorities, alternatives, trade-offs, expected benefits, and success criteria.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to improve feedback on a slow endpoint.
output: Priority one: define the performance target and current baseline.
Priority two: isolate the slow operation before proposing changes.
Priority three: add a verification step that compares response time before and after the fix.

output_examples.input: A team wants a clearer explanation for beginner users.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify jargon, suggest a simpler structure, add a short example, and explain why each change improves comprehension.

output_examples.input: A reviewer found several quality issues in an AI-generated answer.
output: Group the issues by correctness, completeness, and clarity.
Mark urgent fixes before style improvements.
Provide concrete replacement text for the highest-impact sections.

best_practices: Provide the original output and the goal before asking for improvements.
Ask for priorities so urgent fixes are separated from optional refinements.
Request verification steps for any proposed code or process change.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for vague feedback without sharing the target audience or success criteria.
Do not accept broad suggestions that lack concrete implementation steps.
Do not treat examples as validated fixes without review or testing.

faq.question: What does this skill help improve?
faq.answer: It helps improve AI responses, code suggestions, explanations, documentation, and solution plans.

faq.question: Does it make changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides recommendations, examples, priorities, and verification steps for a user or agent to apply.

faq.question: Can it help with security feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes security hardening as one improvement category and can prioritize vulnerability fixes.

faq.question: Is it useful outside software development?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve explanations, communication, documentation, and structured planning tasks.

faq.question: What context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the current output, the intended audience, known issues, constraints, and the desired result.

faq.question: Does it verify that improvements work?
faq.answer: It suggests verification steps and success criteria, but it does not execute tests or inspect results by itself.
